title: Stories from the Bible
author: Retold by Ampli from the King James Bible
source: King James Version (1611, public domain), original retelling by Ampli
description: From the first light of creation to a brave young queen who risked everything for her people, these are the stories that have been told around fires and at bedsides for thousands of years. Settle in and hear ten of the Bible's greatest adventures, retold warmly for listeners of every age.
